detail.title: Experimental Distinctions Between Autocatalytic Memory and Template-Directed Heredity
detail.summary: This notebook explores the conceptual and functional gap between persistent autocatalytic chemical networks (chemical memory) and the onset of heritable information transfer. Evidence suggests that while autocatalytic sets exhibit history-dependence and composition maintenance, they remain distinct from template-directed replication which requires discrete information storage.
